reason: The frozen objective requires exact-capture duration and RGB/depth/camera-info synchronization to be audited before a Source Discovery R1 candidate lock. The original access firewall allowed metadata identity but used the broader phrase member_payload_reads, which is ambiguous for source-native JSON and JSONL metadata stored inside a ZIP.

interpretation.metadata_identity: Includes bounded reads of exact-capture JSON and camera-info JSONL members required to establish frame count, frequency, timestamps, and pose-field presence.
interpretation.candidate_payload: RGB, depth, confidence, mesh, texture, annotation geometry, or any member used to select or score geometry/RGB behavior.

allowed: authenticated HEAD or bounded HTTP range reads for the two already frozen MultiScan ZIP objects
ZIP end record, central directory, and local headers
CRC32 and byte-count validation of those metadata members
forbidden: any depth or confidence stream byte
mesh, texture, annotation, or alignment member payload
candidate expansion, threshold change, or Android execution
authority_effect: This clarification only resolves the minimum evidence access needed by the already frozen source-authority gate. It grants no candidate lock, geometry, RGB, performance, Android, product, or safety authority.
